results.content:
, such as launch videos, social media posts, and interactive web animations.

With Clayzo, agents write animations as code against our format, which covers shapes, text, keyframes, springs, custom effects/shaders, camera moves, audio, and interactive states like hover, press and drag. Use it with your own coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.).

Our CLI lets agents instantly preview any frame, review their own work, and fix what looks off. Animations & assets bundle into a single .clayzo file (up to ~40x smaller than videos). We currently have optimized WebGL/Swift players for any web/iOS/Mac app (working on more), and you can also export to MP4, GIF, WebM or any other video format.

Super simple setup:

1.   Run npx clayzo@latest init

2.   Run the command: clayzo login [...] 2.   Run the command: clayzo login

3.   Access Clayzo with your agent using 2 skills:

    1.   /clayzo-animation-authoring (to create the animation)

    2.   /clayzo-authoring-shipping (for preview and fast export)

Some of the ways we've seen Clayzo being used:

1.   Interactive web animations

2.   Launch videos (entire video made using clayzo!)

Clayzo is free to use! Test it out and let us know what you think!
